panel.title: Delivery and courier
panel.label: Print label
panel.loadFailed: The parcels could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
panel.readyToBook: This order is packed and ready for a courier.
panel.noneYet: No parcel has been booked for this order.
panel.packFirst: Pack the order first. A courier can be booked once the order is packed.

book.title: Book a courier for {number}
book.text: Couriers that can take this parcel are listed first. The recommended one is chosen for you; pick another if you prefer.
book.noneEligible: No courier can take this parcel right now. See the reasons below, then change the weight or the courier rules.
book.unavailable: Couriers that cannot take this parcel
book.weightHint: Leave empty to use the order's weight.
book.dimensionsInvalid: Each side must be a whole number from 1 to 300.
book.bookedText: {courier} will pick up the parcel for {number}.

bulk.title: Book a courier for {count} packed orders
bulk.text: Each order is booked on its own: one failing does not stop the others. Orders that are not packed are left out.
bulk.courierHint: Automatic picks the best eligible courier for every order.
bulk.autoOnly: The best eligible courier will be chosen for each order.

customer.title: Courier and tracking
customer.failedTitle: The courier could not deliver yet
customer.failedText: The delivery attempt failed (attempt {count}). The courier may try again, or send the parcel back to us. We will keep you posted here.
customer.noEvents: The courier has not reported any step yet.

guestCancel.title: Cancel order {number}?
guestCancel.text: The order has not left our shop yet, so it can still be cancelled. The items go back on the shelf and the booking with the courier, if any, is cancelled.
guestCancel.paidNote: You have already paid for this order. Please contact us with the order number about your refund.

desk.couponHint: Optional. The totals update when you pause typing.
desk.overrideHintNone: Leave empty to use the shop charge. It is shown once the totals are ready.
desk.needMore: Add items, a valid customer mobile number and the delivery address to see the exact totals.
desk.short: Not enough stock in this branch
desk.overridden: Delivery charge changed by hand. The shop charge would be {standard}.
desk.advanceNote: This order needs an advance of {amount} before it is confirmed.
desk.exact: The server worked these figures out with the same calculation that saves the order, so the saved order shows the same totals.

returns.title: Return parcel
returns.use: Book a courier for the pickup
returns.useHint: A reverse parcel is booked from the customer's address to the branch. Leave off to note a courier by name.
